newsitem.title: CANADA: Newbridge sees revenue jump with deal.
newsitem.headline: Newbridge sees revenue jump with deal.

text.p: The partnership announced on Friday between Newbridge Networks Corp and Matsushita Communication Industrial Co Ltd should improve Newbridge's revenues significantly, Newbridge president Peter Sommerer said.
"It represents significant upside potential for Newbridge's revenue," Sommerer told reporters after the company's annual meeting.
Newbridge chairman and chief executive officer Terence Matthews, who described Matsushita as one of world's true giants said: "I think in Japan relationships are everything."
Matthews declined to predict by how much revenues would grow.

But one technology analyst Robert MacLellan, with Dillon, Read & Co Inc, told Reuters that the deal through Matsushita with Nippon Telephone & Telegraph could be worth C$250 million in revenue over the next four to five years.
Somewhat less than 20 percent of that would go to the bottom line, the analyst estimated.
MacLellan said he maintained a "table-thumping, screaming buy on the stock."
